definitions.explanation: Both of one's arms. Used to emphasize that both arms are involved in an action.
Two people who serve as one's most trusted and capable assistants. A figurative extension from the literal meaning.

examples.japanese: {両腕|りょううで}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{抱|かか}える→抱える：02031_kakaeru⟧。
{両腕|りょううで}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げて→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧⟦{迎|むか}えた→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
examples.english: I spread both arms wide to welcome them.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{両腕|りょううで}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦しっかり→しっかり：01272_shikkari⟧⟦{抱|だ}きしめた→抱きしめる：06044_dakishimeru⟧。
examples.english: I held the child tightly with both arms.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{両腕|りょううで}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支|ささ}えている→支える：01946_sasaeru⟧。
examples.english: They support the company as the president's right-hand men.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{両腕|りょううで}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれる→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧⟦コーチ→コーチ：03844_koochi⟧だ。
examples.english: He is a coach known as the manager's right-hand man.

examples.japanese: ⟦{優秀|ゆうしゅう}→優秀：03646_yuushuu⟧な⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部下|ぶか}→部下：06453_buka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{両腕|りょううで}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: With two excellent subordinates as my right-hand men, I started a new project.

notes:
{両腕|りょううで} literally refers to both of a person's arms, emphasizing that both are involved in an action such as holding, spreading, or lifting. Figuratively, it can mean two trusted aides or right-hand men who support a leader, extending the image of ⟦{片腕|かたうで}→片腕：13509_kataude⟧ (one's right-hand man) to a pair.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {両腕|りょううで}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{抱|かか}える→抱える：02031_kakaeru⟧ (to hold in both arms)
- {両腕|りょううで}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げる→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧ (to spread both arms)
- {両腕|りょううで}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}む→組む：02050_kumu⟧ (to fold both arms)
- {両腕|りょううで}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{抱|だ}きしめる→抱きしめる：06044_dakishimeru⟧ (to embrace with both arms)

SIMILAR COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{両手|りょうて}→両手：09518_ryoute⟧ (both hands)
- ⟦{両足|りょうあし}→両足：28926_ryouashi⟧ (both legs)
- ⟦{片腕|かたうで}→片腕：13509_kataude⟧ (one arm; one's right-hand man — singular)

USAGE:
- The literal sense (sense 1) is straightforward and common in physical descriptions
- The figurative sense (sense 2) appears in business and organizational contexts
- The ⟦{両|りょう}→両：11182_ryou⟧ prefix follows the same pattern as ⟦{両手|りょうて}→両手：09518_ryoute⟧, ⟦{両足|りょうあし}→両足：28926_ryouashi⟧, ⟦{両目|りょうめ}→両目：21275_ryoume⟧
